candidate_population: Every nonprincipal mode whose direct sign at 5694.5 reverses both archived strict endpoint signs.
criterion: Minimize the independent interval for absolute completed midpoint amplitude divided by the magnitude of its parity-specific completion factor. Ties by smallest frequency. Certify ordering against runner-up.
stage_order: certify interpolation from 12 actual coarse p24 and p28 rows
if needed, recompute only unresolved targets at p48
cost_policy: Time the search separately from the coarse source and its two sparse projections. Charge a cold p48 source separately from the selected p48 projection. Report overlap or failed attempts.
